# definednet_route (Data Source)

Looks up an existing route by ID or by exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "definednet_route" "dc" {
  name = "datacenter"
}

resource "definednet_tag" "dc_clients" {
  name                = "access:datacenter"
  route_subscriptions = [data.definednet_route.dc.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Route ID. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) Exact route name. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Route description.
- `firewall_rules` (Attributes Set) Firewall rules for traffic entering the routed CIDRs. Each rule's `local_cidr` overlaps one of `routable_cidrs`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--firewall_rules))
- `routable_cidrs` (Attributes Map) IPv4 CIDRs reachable through the route, keyed by CIDR. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--routable_cidrs))
- `router_host_id` (String) ID of the host that forwards traffic for this route, if any.

<a id="nestedatt--firewall_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `firewall_rules`

Read-Only:

- `allowed_role_id` (String) Only hosts with this role are allowed. Null allows every role.
- `allowed_tags` (Set of String) Only hosts carrying every one of these `key:value` tags are allowed. Null allows any tags.
- `description` (String) Optional description, at most 255 characters.
- `local_cidr` (String) IPv4 CIDR overlapping one of `routable_cidrs` that this rule applies to, or `ANY` for the whole route.
- `port_range` (Attributes) Inclusive port range. Null allows every port. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--firewall_rules--port_range))
- `protocol` (String) Allowed protocol: `ANY`, `TCP`, `UDP`, or `ICMP`.

<a id="nestedatt--firewall_rules--port_range"></a>
### Nested Schema for `firewall_rules.port_range`

Read-Only:

- `from` (Number) First port in the range (1-65535).
- `to` (Number) Last port in the range (1-65535), at least `from`.



<a id="nestedatt--routable_cidrs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `routable_cidrs`

Read-Only:

- `install` (Boolean) Whether subscribed hosts install the route into their kernel routing table.
